Bill.BriefDescription: Clarifying the role of a chief financial officer in a charter county.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to chief financial officers in charter counties;and amending RCW 36.22.140.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.22.140 and 1995 c 301 s 61 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each county auditor or ((chief)) financial officer designated in acharter county shall be ex officio deputy of the state auditor for thepurpose of accounting and reporting on municipal corporations and insuch capacity shall be under the direction of the state auditor, but heor she shall receive no additional salary or compensation by virtuethereof and shall perform no duties as such, except in connection withcounty business.
